decisions.D5: Left-out features: deferred commits, group commit, IndexedDB, Cloudflare, alarms, JSONL, key-value store, table prefix, read cache.
decisions.D8: pi-ai is not brought over; tests needing real providers and tokens do not run.
decisions.D14: Pinned tests with no spec section behind them, and tests of pi-durable's own source layout.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-blocked.test.ts :: recovery at open > keeps the host's wake active until open's recovery pass has landed
tests.reason: alarms: Asserts the sequence of onWake calls during recovery.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-context-range.test.ts :: kept context ranges > is not advanced when an entry was committed while its scan ran off the line
tests.reason: pinned, no spec section backs it: advanceRange()/readContextFrom() from src/harness/context.ts: A race between a scan off the line and the private range cache; the spec only promises tail-only scans, not this interleaving.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-deferred-progress.test.ts :: generation partials > converts a stored partial once through two crashes, before and after the conversion
tests.reason: deferred commits: Asserts the resend's partials stay unstored until the crash.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-deferred-progress.test.ts :: generation partials > hold partials in memory and store them together, at most every persistWithinMs
tests.reason: deferred commits: Asserts partials are held in memory and stored less often than shown.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-deferred-progress.test.ts :: generation partials > leaves no aborted entry for a stream that crashed before its first store
tests.reason: deferred commits: Requires partials to be lost with the process; committed partials leave an aborted entry.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-deferred-progress.test.ts :: reading pi.live in a commit > stores the held partial a third-party task's commit read, with what it derived
tests.reason: deferred commits: Tests a commit reading pi.live storing what was held.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-group-commit.test.ts :: group commit: reads on the line > reads no task record from Storage for more live and awaited tasks than the record cache's count
tests.reason: read cache: Asserts the record cache serves all task reads.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-group-commit.test.ts :: group commit: records a decision copies > marks a child in a cascade from its current record, not one its pending commit replaces
tests.reason: group commit: Needs a commit callback to run while another commit's storage call is in flight.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-group-commit.test.ts :: group commit: records a decision copies > marks the other tasks of a failFast wait from their current records
tests.reason: group commit: Needs a commit callback to run while another commit's storage call is in flight.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-idle-scopes.test.ts :: incremental idle state > equals a full recompute after every step of random nested work
tests.reason: pinned, no spec section backs it: SCHEDULER_IDLE_STATE scheduler counters: Checks a private incremental index equals its private full recompute.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-idle-scopes.test.ts :: kept context ranges > drops a range from the expiry order when an entry commit cannot extend it
tests.reason: pinned, no spec section backs it: SCHEDULER_IDLE_STATE scheduler counters: The expiry order is a private structure; no spec section describes it.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-idle-scopes.test.ts :: kept context ranges > drops a range from the expiry order when an entry commit finds it expired
tests.reason: pinned, no spec section backs it: SCHEDULER_IDLE_STATE scheduler counters: The expiry order is a private structure; no spec section describes it.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-idle-scopes.test.ts :: kept context ranges > drops a range past its retention at a reconcile pass with nothing to do, with background timers declined (review)
tests.reason: pinned, no spec section backs it: SCHEDULER_IDLE_STATE scheduler counters: The reconcile pass with no work is a private scheduler step.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-idle-scopes.test.ts :: kept context ranges > expires in idle order when the clock goes back
tests.reason: pinned, no spec section backs it: SCHEDULER_IDLE_STATE scheduler counters: Expiry order under a clock going backwards is not specified.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-idle-scopes.test.ts :: kept context ranges > settles a run end whose sweep drops the chain without a check of every scope
tests.reason: pinned, no spec section backs it: SCHEDULER_IDLE_STATE scheduler counters: Asserts that a sweep avoids a full idle check, a private cost counter with no spec promise.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-json.test.ts :: assignJson > does not merge a new __proto__ member into Object.prototype
tests.reason: pinned, no spec section backs it: assignJson() from src/harness/json.ts: The spec has no rule for a __proto__ key inside streamed JSON, and the test calls a private helper on a Chord tracker.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-live-deltas.test.ts :: pi.live deltas > hands a generation over to its tool round and starts a tool with one field write each
tests.reason: deferred commits: Exact ops encode deferred attempt and running status folded into later commits.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-ownership.test.ts :: owned conversations from tools and supervisors > runs a handle operation queued behind the abort mark before the mark's publication, and the cascade aborts it

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-sleep.test.ts :: sleeping tasks > arms a foreground timer the host declines with setTimeout, reporting it once
tests.reason: alarms: Tests setTimer declining a timer.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-sleep.test.ts :: sleeping tasks > arms no timer for sleeps with onWake
tests.reason: alarms: Tests the onWake alarm replacing the sleep timer.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-sleep.test.ts :: sleeping tasks > reports a throwing onWake and offers the same wake again at the next pass
tests.reason: alarms: Tests onWake delivery and retry.

tests.test: upstream/test/harness-storage-failure.test.ts :: a failed Storage call > fails it for a throw in its own commit listeners, which would leave memory behind storage
tests.reason: pinned, no spec section backs it: followCommits() via cast: A throw from the Session's own listeners is specified (section 4), but no public API can install such a listener, so it cannot be expressed.

tests.reason: pinned, no spec section backs it: contained() from src/session/session.ts: Thenable and cross-realm handling of a private containment helper; no spec section covers these shapes.
